selector.rationale: Hyperkeratotic plaques with atrophic centers and elevated edges, along with histopathological findings of hyperkeratosis, parakeratotic columns, and dyskeratotic keratinocytes, are characteristic of porokeratosis, particularly the genital type.

rejected.label: Darier's disease
rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathological features such as suprabasal acantholytic dyskeratosis

rejected.label: lichen sclerosus
rejected.why: Typically presents with white, atrophic patches and histological features of sclerosis, not seen in this case

rejected.label: psoriasis
rejected.why: Classic psoriatic lesions are erythematous, scaly plaques, not matching the described gray hyperkeratotic plaques

rejected.label: seborrheic keratosis
rejected.why: Contradicted by the presence of atrophic centers and specific histopathological features not typical of seborrheic keratosis
